verdict.rationale: The Agents SDK provides persistent, stateful agent runtimes built on Durable Objects, each with its own state and storage, that hibernate and wake on demand. The Think harness adds automatic message persistence, stream resumption and workspace/bash tools backed by Durable Object SQLite, and Workflows persist state across steps with automatic retries. That covers the persistence half of the story, but automatic checkpointing of a coding agent's working state (for example workspace or sandbox filesystem snapshots taken mid-task) is only implied, not documented. Missing for 10: explicit automatic checkpoint/snapshot of the coding workspace or sandbox state, restore-from-checkpoint docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can give my coding agent a persistent runtime environment that checkpoints its state automatically while working

citations.quote: Agents are persistent, stateful execution environments for agentic workloads, powered by Cloudflare Durable Objects. Each agent has its own state, storage, and lifecycle
message persistence, streaming, client tools, stream resumption, and extensions — all backed by Durable Object SQLite
automatically retry failed tasks, and persist state for minutes, hours, or even weeks - with no infrastructure to manage
Agents hibernate when idle and wake on demand.
